card.name: Length, extent and duration words
card.fires_on: Words that describe size, extent or span, such as length, circumference, last, over or take, just before a quantity or comparison is given.

modes.label: Size and measure nouns
modes.description: Nouns like length or circumference that introduce a measurement or comparison.
modes.example: The middle-sized stick should be about three-quarters the<< length>> of the longest one.

modes.description: Words such as take, over or -year that lead into a time span.

modes.label: Ordinal or range words
modes.description: Words like last, or a final digit of a number, in a sequence or counting range.
